researchEvidence.note: Official DLCP asbestos abatement business page reviewed; it lists asbestos abatement business requirements and license terms.

Official DOEE asbestos permitting page reviewed; it states licensed abatement contractors submit notification packages online and that businesses must have a valid District basic business license and Clean Hands certificate to perform asbestos abatement in the District.
Official SCOUT lookup retained as the broad public verification path, pending adapter review for asbestos abatement business filters.
